subject: Proposed ramp & MAP: commit bridge and consumption smoothing
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@hexaretail.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 15:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial evaluation kickoff and questions

Thanks Rachel — good talk today. Alicia and I sketched a possible evaluation plan but we need clarity on how you expect the trial to translate to committed TPMs. Our procurement lead (procurement@hexaretail.com) wants a one-page milestone table for legal and finance that ties spend to acceptance gates. Can you send something concrete we can share?

High level constraints: budget quarter ends Sep 30, need vendor on contract by mid-August to lock pricing, and production traffic expected to ramp in October.

Samir
Business Ops, HexaRetail

>
> Next steps: I’ll loop in Marissa and Ben to confirm the technical acceptance gates and the discount ladder.
>
> Rachel
> Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@hexaretail.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@hexaretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + draft TPM bridge (attached)

Samir / Alicia — attached is the one-pager you can share with procurement and finance. Quick summary of the plan inside:

- 6-week evaluation (Jun 28 — Aug 9): proof-of-concept with 10M TPM cap for functional tests, success criteria: 95th pctl latency < 400ms, model accuracy on sample prompts within agreed eval set (we'll share detailed eval results).
- Bridge month (Aug): reduced pilot price, 20M TPM expected, retention of KV cache and prefixes to speed go-live.
- Ramp (Sep–Nov): target monthly TPMs = Sep 30M, Oct 60M, Nov 120M leading into committed annual TPM starting Dec 1.

Pricing & discounts (draft):
- Evaluation: free credits + $0.00095/token for overage during eval.
- Bridge month: $0.0009/token with 5% rebate if Sep commit >= 30M TPM.
- Ramp/Commit: baseline $0.0008/token at 120M TPM; additional tiered discounts at 250M and 500M TPM with step-downs to $0.00065/token.

Attached: 2026-06-30_MAP-draft.pdf (one-pager), SOW_v0.2.docx (scope + acceptance gates).

Please confirm whether procurement needs any other line items (term, termination, data residency). If this looks broadly OK I’ll turn it into a mutually executable MAP and propose dates for a legal checklist review with your procurement contact.

Thanks — Rachel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: 2026-06-30_MAP-draft.pdf (pdf), SOW_v0.2.docx (docx)

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@hexaretail.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Patel <samir@hexaretail.com>
Cc: procurement@hexaretail.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2026 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + draft TPM bridge (attached)

Rachel — this is helpful, thank you. A few quick procurement asks:
- Can you convert the pricing bands into a table with monthly committed TPM and per-token effective rate so finance can model budget impact?
- Need a short clause on data retention (HexaRetail requires 90-day KV retention max for eval).
- Can you confirm whether the bridge month counts toward the annual commit or will be credited separately?

Also — on our side we may need a conservative fallback: if Oct ramp misses by >30% we will request a temporary credit or extended trial window. That will be in our procurement terms; we understand you need predictable revenue but need some guardrails while we validate customer-facing integrations.

Would love Marissa or Ben to confirm acceptance criteria wording in the SOW.

—Alicia
Head of Product, HexaRetail

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@hexaretail.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@hexaretail.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + draft TPM bridge (attached)

Looping internal owners per Alicia's asks. Short answers / proposals below so Rachel can update the MAP table and return to procurement: 

- Pricing table: see proposed effective rates below (Rachel, I’ll let you add to the doc):
  * Eval overage: $0.00095/token (no change)
  * Bridge (Aug): committed 20M TPM at $0.00090/token; if Sep >=30M TPM we apply a 5% rebate to Aug invoice.
  * Ramp commits (Dec annual start): tiered commit bands with effective per-token rates: 120M -> $0.00080, 250M -> $0.00072, 500M -> $0.00065.

- Data retention: we can support 90-day KV retention for the eval environment (add clause in SOW). Production retention will follow standard policy unless Hexa opts into shorter retention for PII workloads.

- Bridge credit if ramp misses: we can offer a single 30-day grace credit equal to 25% of the shortfall month invoice if Oct falls below 70% of target, as long as Hexa provides a written remediation plan and schedules a weekly ops cadence for October–December. This is intended as a one-time operational buffer, not a recurring concession.

- Acceptance gates: Ben — pls confirm the SLO wording for latency and sample prompt accuracy; Dylan — confirm we can reserve 20M TPM in Aug in Dedicated pool (or hosted with guaranteed burst).

Rachel — once Ben/Dylan confirm I recommend adding the table and credit language to the MAP PDF and sending back to procurement for legal. I can support the deal desk for final pricing sign-off.

Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
